Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan were brilliant with the ball. Mohammad Amir spearheaded them with a 3-wicket haul while Imad Wasim also left his impact. The others were decent as well barring Usman Shinwari who went for aplenty. The pitch has some spin to offer and if Sri Lanka manage to get some early wickets, it's game on. Do join us in a short while for the run chase.

After opting to bat, Sri Lanka started sensibly but then lost wickets in a flurry. Oshada Fernando then steadied the ship somewhat through a little stand with Angelo Perera and then finally came a partnership of substance between Fernando and Dasun Shanaka. That put the Lankan innings on the right path but they failed to finish it on a high. Just 13 runs came in the last two overs.

Let's begin with an interesting observation by one of our scorers - All the wickets have fallen on the last ball of the over. Sharp one! Let's summarize this first half. In one sentence - A clumsy Pakistan have managed to restrict Sri Lanka under 150. Top effort by their bowlers and had their fielders supported aptly, the final total would have been a lot lesser.

OUT! Run out! Shinwari nails his yorker this time. It's around off and Fernando just manages to dig it out. They attempt for a quick run and the bowler attacks the ball. He picks up the ball, breaks the stumps and finds Hasaranga short. The third umpire finds the same in the replays. SRI LANKA END ON 147/7!
Good delivery by Usman on this occasion. Follows the batsman down the leg side with a very full ball. Wanindu drills it down to long on for one.
Once again fails to nail the yorker and it's a low full toss on middle and leg. Oshada fails to get underneath it and whips it to deep mid-wicket for just a run, in spite of the misfield.
Shinwari looks for a yorker but serves a full toss instead. It's pumped down to long off for a single.
Fires in a very full ball on middle, Wanindu flicks it across the line but finds square leg. DOT!
FOUR! Up and over mid off. Good start to the last over for Sri Lanka. Back of a length ball around off, Hasaranga stays back and chips it over the infield for a boundary.
Wanindu Hasaranga is in now! Usman Shinwari to bowl the final over of the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Madushanka perishes in trying to up the ante! Full delivery outside off, Madushanka looks to loft it over the mid off fielder but is not able to clear him. Iftikhar runs in from mid off and takes an excellent sliding catch. Third wicket for Mohammad Amir in this innings. He finishes with, 4-0-27-3!

Full delivery on middle, Madushanka drives this straight but Amir puts his foot in between and stops the ball. He seems to have stepped on the ball. Excellent footwork from Mohammad Amir. They are changing the ball.
Short ball on middle, Fernando looks to pull but does not time it well and it goes towards deep mid-wicket. The batters take single. They think of a couple but it is not there.
BEATEN! Much better from Amir! Yorker length outside off, Oshada looks to keep it out but does not get anything on it.
FOUR! Very well played from Oshada! Full delivery outside off, Oshada plays a paddle sweep over the fine leg fielder for a boundary. He has played a blinder of an innings here.
Good length delivery on middle, Lahiru defends it towards the cover region and takes a single.
Lahiru Madushanka is the new man in!

OUT! Fantastic running catch by Fakhar Zaman to put Shanaka out of his misery. He never got going but nonetheless was involved in a handy 76-run stand with Oshada Fernando. A timely breakthrough for Pakistan. Wahab angles across a back of a length delivery outside off, Shanaka makes room and slams it aerially over cover-point. Fakhar charges from the deep and dives low to grab the catch inches over the surface. Finally a wicket to Wahab's name on the last ball of his spell. A few catches went down off his bowling.
Beaten! Good length delivery following the batsman outside off, Shanaka tries playing the paddle scoop but misses. Wahab quickly gets to the ball and Oshada speeds back to his end.
Wide! Riaz loses his radar completely and slips a delivery way wide outside off.
Play and a miss! Full in length and wide outside off, Dasun chases and misses as the ball also stays a bit low.
Direct hit would have been curtains for Oshada. He forces a length ball to extra cover and scoots to the other end. The fielder misses his shy and that gives a life to Fernando.
SIX! Crispy hit...helped on its way! Wahab's pace working against him. Fractionally short in length on middle, Oshada rotates his wrists and dispatches it over square leg for a maximum.
Short in length around off, Shanaka hurries down the track and mishits his attempted shot to mid off for a run.
Slower delivery outside off, Oshada does not pick it while trying to flick it and fails to put any bat on it.

FOUR! Nicely played by Fernando! Short delivery on middle, Fernando pulls it towards the deep square leg region for a boundary. Fakhar Zaman runs in from deep mid-wicket and tries to stop it but it bounces off his hand and goes into the fence. Another piece of poor fielding from Pakistan.

NOT OUT! NO BAT! Yorker length delivery outside off, Oshada fails to keep it out and the ball goes to the keeper who appeals for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Sarfaraz goes for the review and the Ultra Edge shows that the sound was off the bat hitting the ground. Pakistan lose their only review.
REVIEW TIME! Appeal for caught behind, given not out and Pakistan have gone for the review.
SIX! Beautiful shot! Full delivery on middle, Oshada lofts this nicely over the long on fielder for a maximum! The fielder tries to catch it but is unable to stop it from going for a maximum.
WIDE! Slower delivery way outside off, Fernando lets it go to the keeper.

Full delivery on middle, Oshada drives this towards mid off and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. If he had hit, the batsman was well out as he had given up. The ball goes towards fine leg which allows the batsmen to take another run.
Good length ball outside off, Shanaka pushes it to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
Mohammad Amir is back into the attack. 2-0-7-2, his numbers so far.

DROPPED! Wahab cannot believe his luck. Short delivery again, Oshada tries to whip it across the line but gets a leading edge onto it. Shinwari runs across to his right from third man, overruns a bit in fact and drops it. He tries his best after that to pull the ball back in but seems to be late in doing that. It's checked upstairs and Shinwari has done well to save two runs.

DROPPED! Short in length on middle, Shanaka muscles it across the line to deep square leg where Asif Ali probably loses the sight of the ball and puts down the catch to his right with an attempted dive. A bit late into it. A single is taken.
Wide called for height! Wahab digs in a short ball around leg, Dasun is down on his knee before making a leave.
A full toss outside off but Oshada manages only to hit it as far as the extra cover fielder. He scampers across to the other end as Haris Sohail misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Fernando tries to use the pace of the bowler and ramp it down to third man but fails to connect.
Shortish and outside off, Dasun goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Fifty for Oshada Fernando on his T20I debut! Has batted exceptionally this evening! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Fernando works it behind square leg for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Oshada works it towards square leg and takes a single.
Short ball outside off, Shanaka camps back and pushes it towards the cover region for a single.

Flighted delivery outside off, Fernando puts on his dancing shoes and drives this uppishly towards long off. Asif Ali runs in from mid off and tries to make a diving stop. He makes a half stop and the ball is rolling towards the boundary again. Asif gets up and dives again to stop the ball. The umpires go to check whether it is a boundary or not but the third umpire finds it to be a clean stop. The batters take a double in the meantime. Asif took an excellent catch previously in the match and now makes an excellent stop.
Flat delivery on middle, Fernando flicks it towards the leg side for a single. 100 up for Sri Lanka.
EDGED AND FOUR! Tossed up ball around off, Fernando looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper and into the third man fence.
Shadab Khan into the attack for his final over.
Flat delivery outside off, Shanaka pushes it towards the cover region for a single.
BEATEN! Slower delivery outside the off stump line, Fernando looks to guide it but does not put any bat on it.
WIDE! Good length delivery down the leg side, Fernando moves towards the off side but misses. It is wided.
WIDE! Wahab bowls a bouncer way above Fernando's head and it is wided.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Fernando looks to guide it to third man but fails to put any bat on it.

Good length delivery outside off, Shanaka moves towards the off side and looks to pull but gets hit on the pads. Wahab appeals but nothing from the umpire. It was going outside the off stump. The batters take a leg bye!
Good length ball outside off, Dasun shoulders arms to this one. Very seldomly you see this in T20Is.
On a length on middle and leg, Fernando flicks it towards square leg and crosses over for another single.
Full delivery on middle, Shanaka flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Wahab Riaz is back on!
Turning away from the batsman, it's pushed off the front foot to point. Excellent over from Wasim as only two runs came from it. He has bowled out now, 4-0-18-1. Exceptional work.

BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Fernando looks to guide it but fails to put any bat on it. It's bowled slower through the air which might have made the batsman miss it. Sarfaraz struggles to gather the ball.
Full delivery on middle, Shanaka flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a single. They wanted a couple but it is not there.
Short ball on middle, Shanaka defends it off the back foot.
Flatter again around off, Shanaka comes down the track and defends it off the back foot.
Flat delivery on middle and leg, Oshada flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and blocks it back. 11 from the over.
Flatter and fuller on off, stroked through covers for one.
FOUR! Brilliant, absolutely brilliant from Oshada! He is oozing with confidence. Fancy footwork by him to get to the pitch of the ball and then he lofts it over extra cover. Gorgeous.
Gets down on one knee for the paddle sweep but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Fullish and off, driven down to wide long off for a couple.
FOUR! Pure timing. Flighted delivery landing full outside off, Fernando leans into the drive and drives it a bit uppishly but in the gap at extra cover.
Shadab Khan (2-0-11-0) is back on.
Full delivery on middle, Dasun defends it towards the bowler.
Short ball on off, Fernando guides it towards short third man and crosses over for a single.

STUMPING CHANCE MISSED! Flighted delivery down the leg side, Dasun comes down the track to flick but misses the ball completely. Sarfaraz fails to collect it cleanly and the ball goes behind him. His sight was probably blocked by the batsman which led to the missed stumping. Pakistan's fielding has been poor tonight and they sincerely need to improve. It's called a wide as well.
Flat delivery outside off, Shanaka pushes it towards the point region.
Full delivery on middle, Shanaka defends it to the bowler.
Flat delivery on middle, Oshada flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Short ball outside off, Oshada pushes it towards point.
Imad Wasim is back on. He has two overs left up his sleeves. 2-0-12-1, so far.
Slow, full delivery on middle, Oshada drives this uppishly towards the long on fielder and takes a single. Good over for Sri Lanka. 11 runs came off it.
Full delivery on middle, Dasun flicks it towards square leg and takes off for a single.
BEATEN! Beauty! Good length ball outside off, Shanaka looks to guide towards third man but fails to put any bat on it and it goes straight to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, Oshada tucks it towards square leg and crosses over for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Fernando! Poor delivery from Usman! Bowls a short delivery down the leg side, Oshada rocks back and pulls it nicely towards the fine leg region for another boundary. Sarfaraz has a few words to his bowler after that ball.

FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery on middle, Oshada dances down the track while moving towards the leg side and lofts this over the mid off fielder for a boundary. He has looked good against the pacers so far.
Usman Shinwari is back into the attack!
Flatter and shorter on middle, Fernando goes deep inside the crease and punches it down to long on for one.
Knocks a full ball down to long on and picks up a run to open his account.
Dasun has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A slip comes in.
Whoa! Great turn for Shadab. Loopy and full on middle, Shanaka tries to defend but it spins past the outside edge.
Full and flighted on off, it's forced down to long off for one.
Beautiful leg spinner by Shadab. He lands it close to the off stump line and gets it to curl away from the batsman. Oshada tries to play late at it but is beaten.
Sri Lanka captain, Dasun Shanaka is the new man in!

OUT! RUN OUT! Angelo has to go here! Poor running between the wickets from the batsmen! Good length ball outside off, Perera guides this towards the backward point region and calls Fernando for a couple. In the meantime, Iftikhar runs in fast and sends in a good flat throw to Sarfaraz who does well to remove the bails. The third umpire is referred. Angelo should have dived to make it into the crease but doesn't and he has to go back. Inches short in the replays. Sri Lanka are four down now!
Run out appeal against Perera is taken upstairs. That looks close. It's a risky couple. Let's see if that costs Sri Lanka a wicket...
Good length ball outside off, Angelo plays it nicely towards the backward point region for a couple. Iftikhar Ahmad runs in from third man and makes a clean stop.
Short ball on middle, Fernando pulls it towards backward square leg and takes another single.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! On a length on off, Perera defends it off the back foot towards point and calls for a single. Shadab runs in and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. If he had hit, Fernando would have been on his way back.
Full delivery on middle, Angelo flicks it towards the mid-wicket fielder for nothing.
Full delivery outside off, Oshada looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards the third man region and they cross for a single.
Wahab Riaz has been introduced into the attack.
Full delivery outside off, Fernando looks to play a paddle sweep but mistimes it towards mid on for a single. 8 from the over, Sri Lanka trying to recover.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Short ball outside off, Perera rocks back and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fielder for a couple as the fielder misfields slightly. 50 up for the visitors.
FOUR! Nicely played! Flighted ball on middle, Angelo dances down the track and plays it straight down the ground and finds the fence at long on.

Flighted ball on off and middle, Angelo comes down the track to defend it but gets hit on the pads. Sarfaraz appeals but nothing from the umpire. The batsman was way down the track and that is why the umpire had given it not out.
Flat delivery around off, Angelo defends it towards the off side for nothing.
Time for some leg spin! Shadab Khan to roll his arm.
Slower delivery outside off, Fernando leaves it alone. 14 runs have come from this over, 44 in the Powerplay for Sri Lanka. But worryingly they have lost three top order wickets as well.
The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the third man region. They pick up a single.
On length outside off, Fernando guides it towards the third man fielder for a single.

Slower yorker on off, Fernando guides this towards third man and calls his partner for a couple. The fielder at third man runs in and cleans it up and throws it to Sarfaraz but the batsman was well in. Sarfaraz does not look happy as the fielder was lazy to get to it and allowed an easy couple.
SIX! What a shot from Fernando! Full delivery on middle, Oshada plays a straight lofted drive over the bowler's head for the first maximum of the game. Excellent batting this.
FOUR! Good length delivery on the pads, Oshada plays a flick towards the fine leg region for a boundary. He is off the mark with that one.
Oshada Fernando makes his way out to the middle! Usman Shinwari comes back into the attack!

OUT! All nicely done. Asif Ali has taken a clinical catch near the fence! Rajapaksa fails to deliver this time. He attempts to heave a length ball across the line but the connection ain't proper. It has got height but not enough distance. Asif at the edge of the rope at deep square leg does well to catch the ball and keep himself inside the line. Good balancing job. Amir is delighted after foxing the batsman with a slower one, Sri Lanka are off to a bad start here.
Rajapaksa is caught near the fence. A good attempt by the fielder. The umpires though want to get it checked upstairs. The replays find it to be clean.
A length delivery outside off, cutting away from the left-hander, Bhanuka pushes it from the crease to the point fielder.
Takes the pace off this one and lands it on a length close to the off stump line. Rajapaksa defends it back towards the bowler.
The line once again is straight from Amir and Perera flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Bhanuka closes the face of his bat and works it through square leg for a run.
Slower and fuller one outside off, Rajapaksa pushes it with gentle hands to the cover fielder.
Angelo Perera is the new batsman.

OUT! LBW! Sadeera has to make the long walk back! Flatter delivery on off, skidding in with the arm, Sadeera looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Imad and the rest of the team appeal and the umpire immediately gives it out. Samarawickrama does not even wait to consult his partner for the review and walks back to the pavilion. Pretty adjacent to the stumps. Good start from Pakistan here, they have picked up two quick wickets.

DROPPED! Shadab Khan makes a mess of this catch! Flighted ball on off, Rajapaksa rocks back to smack it on the leg side but the ball goes way up in the air off the top edge. Shadab Khan comes in from mid on and settles himself under it but doesn't hold onto it. Poor fielding this as this was the catch for Babar Azam who would have found it easier to take the catch as he was standing at mid off. It pops behind them and a single is taken. Pakistan once again have been poor in the field.
Flighted ball on middle, Sadeera comes down the track and flicks it nicely towards deep square leg for a single.
Another short delivery outside off, Rajapaksa cuts it towards the point fielder who dives to his right to stop the ball. The batters take the single.
BEATEN! Short ball outside off, Rajapaksa attempts to cut it but fails to put any bat on it.
Flighted ball on middle, Sadeera flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Hero of the last match, Bhanuka Rajapaksa is in next! Imad Wasim gets a change of ends.

OUT! Timber! The Lahore crowd loved it as the in-form batsman is out of here. First wicket of the series for Mohammad Amir. He sticks to his line around off and serves it on a good length. Gunathilaka shapes up for a big heave across the line but it takes the inside edge and cannons onto the stumps.
Short ball outside off, Gunathilaka defends it out.

DROPPED! Sarfaraz is the culprit! Amir bowls a good length delivery outside off, Sadeera for the third time tries to push inside the line and this time he has edged it behind to the keeper. Sarfaraz dives to his right and attempts the catch with one hand but fails to hold it. His weight was on the left foot and that's why he may have misjudged the the ball. Lucky break for Sadeera.
Beaten once again! Another delivery leaving the right-hander outside off, Samarawickrama tries to run it down to third man but misses.
Beaten! Much better line from Amir. He hurls across a back of a length ball outside off, leaving the batsman with the angle, Sadeera pushes inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Classy! What a way to welcome the bowler! Amir is too straight in his line, Samarawickrama gets forward and across before flicking it aerially behind square leg for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Mohammad Amir replaces Imad Wasim from this end.
Good length ball outside off, Sadeera guides this nicely towards the third man region for another single. Good over for Sri Lanka as 11 runs have come from it.
Slower delivery on middle, Danushka flicks it towards short fine leg where the fielder runs in and cleans it up. The batters cross for a single.
Short ball outside off, Gunathilaka pushes it off the back foot towards cover.

FIVE WIDES! Poor delivery from Shinwari! Good length ball down the leg side, Danushka looks to flick but misses the ball completely. The ball goes past the diving Sarfaraz and into the fine leg fence for five wides. Bonus runs for the Lankans.
Good length ball around off, Gunathilaka looks to punch it away but does not time it well and it goes towards mid off off the upper half of the bat.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Sadeera looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the third man fielder for a single.
WIDE! Bowls a full delivery down the leg side keeping a little low, Sadeera looks to flick but misses and it is wided.
Good length ball on middle, Sadeera flicks it nicely towards the mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder runs in from deep square leg and cuts it off.
Usman Shinwari will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! It's sliced over the infield! Flighted delivery landing full and wide outside off, Gunathilaka gets forward and throws his bat at it. The ball skids away a shade and catches the outside portion of his bat. It flies over the cover-point region and beats Iftikhar Ahmed who was giving the chase from inside the ring.
Quicker and flatter on the pads, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Good stop! Shortish and outside off, Danushka gets back to punch it through the line but it takes the outer half and runs to short third man. Amir dives to his left to stop the ball.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked behind square leg and the short fine leg fielder ran across to his left to stop the ball. They cross for a run. Samarawickrama is also off the mark.
Another arm ball around off, on the shorter side and skidding into the batsman, Sadeera punches it from the back foot to covers.
Starts with a flatter arm ball on the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it in the gap at deep mid-wicket and opens his account with three runs. That's a bit rare at the start of the innings.

Time to get underway! The Pakistani team is in a huddle near the boundary line. Danushka Gunathilaka and Sadeera Samarawickrama are the Lankan openers. Spin to begin - Imad Wasim has the ball in his hand.

Roshan Abeysinghe has Bhanuka Rajapaksa for a quick chat. On his emergence in the national side after playing nearly 10 years in domestic cricket, Rajapaksa says that it's a hard fought effort. Adds he knocked the door for the longest time but couldn't get in. Believes he has grabbed the opportunity well. Mentions that not getting the chance was frustrating but adds that he kept working hard and eventually got the opportunity. On his aim going forward, Rajapaksa says that he wants to play all the three formats of the game.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman, Haris Sohail (In for Ahmed Shehzad), Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Asif Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed (In for Umar Akmal), Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Usman Shinwari (In for Mohammad Hasnain).

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Sadeera Samarawickrama (WK) (In for Minod Bhanuka), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Angelo Perera (In for Avishka Fernando), Oshada Fernando (On T20I debut) (In for Shehan Jayasuriya), Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Lahiru Madushanka (In for Isuru Udana), Lakshan Sandakan, Kasun Rajitha, Lahiru Kumara (In for Nuwan Pradeep).
Toss - Up goes the coin and it falls in favour of Dasun Shanaka. SRI LANKA WILL BAT! As many as five changes made by the Islanders while Pakistan have made three changes to their Playing XI.

Hello and welcome everyone! Only face-saving is left as far as the number 1 T20I team is concerned after getting outclassed in back-to-back games by an inexperienced Sri Lankan outfit. The touring team, on the other hand, will be eyeing their first-ever series whitewash in this format. We're expecting changes in both the sides and will have to wait for that. The Lahore crowd has come in large numbers for the last game of the series and the stadium has turned pink to create awareness about breast cancer. Can the home team give something to cheer for the locals? Stay with us to find out...
